'''Rafe Finna''' was a licensed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Finna owned and operated the [[Light Patrol Ship]] ''[[Icy Moon]]''.
